goal_a_reason: Free-text replies may be paraphrased (e.g. 'Hi Alice!' vs 'Hello, Alice!'), so semantic similarity via an LLM judge is needed; no tool-call inspection is required, ruling out trajectory types.
goal_b_reason: The output is a known structured JSON object where key ordering and minor whitespace differences must be tolerated but values must match, making the deterministic tree-based json-similarity evaluator the right fit.
goal_c_reason: The pass/fail criterion is simply whether the literal substring 'deployment succeeded' appears anywhere in the output, which is exactly what the deterministic contains evaluator checks.
